Here’s how to handle this from a desktop on Gulf South’s website:

1) Log in and find the card section  
- Go to Gulf South Credit Union’s website and sign in.  
- After logging in, look for one of these in the main menu or dashboard:  
  - “Credit Cards”  
  - “Cards” or “Card Services”  
  - “Card Management” or “Manage Cards”  
- Click that, then select your “Everyday Cash Rewards” card if it shows a list of cards.

2) Report the card lost  
On the card details/management page, look for options like:  
- “Report Lost/Stolen”  
- “Report Card Lost or Stolen”  
- A button or link labeled “Lost” or “Stolen”

Then:  
- Choose “Lost” (not stolen, unless you believe someone has it and is using it).  
- Confirm that you want the current card blocked.  

3) Request a replacement and enter the work address  
During the lost‑card process (or right after), you should see an option to request a replacement card and confirm/update the mailing address.  
- If you see “Send replacement to address on file” vs “Use a different address,” choose “Use a different address” or “Add alternate address.”  
- Enter this address exactly:

  U.S. Army Corps of Engineers  
  ATTN: Keisha Brown  
  7400 Leake Ave  
  New Orleans, LA 70118  

- Double‑check each line and the ZIP code.  
- If there’s a notes or comments box, you can add:  
  “Please send this replacement card to my work address above. Keep my home address as primary on file.”

- Click “Submit,” “Confirm,” or “Finish.”  
- Look for a confirmation screen or message with a reference number and (if shown) an estimated arrival date.  
- If there’s no clear confirmation, or if you don’t see an option for a different address, use their “Secure Message” or “Contact Us” in online banking and send:

  U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, ATTN: Keisha Brown, 7400 Leake Ave, New Orleans, LA 70118.  
  Please confirm the shipping address and estimated arrival date.”
